name: Nuoc che xanh
summary: Nước chè xanh is green tea from thick leaves, just short of old. The liquor is sharp at first and sweet after, green, fragrant, and hot.
origin: Vinh. The city introduction puts the tea under đặc sản, before kẹo cu đơ.
taste: The city introduction says the liquor is sharp at first and sweet after, green, fragrant, and hot, and that the company is part of the drink.
howToEat: Drink it hot, with other people if you want the fifth cho. The city introduction says the first sip is sharp and the aftertaste is sweet, the liquor is a green nái, and the smell is light. Some people drink three or four bowls in the morning before eating. The city introduction also says a sore back can be met with sugarcane molasses in a strong cup. A street was not printed.
